scores.notes: Moses raises the rod at the rock as water gushes out, Aaron beside him, people filling jars and drinking with sheep, goats, cattle and a donkey. White unpainted paper shows at the edges and corners (top right, bottom), which this style accepts; Aaron's breastplate is plain squares, no letters.

Bald Elisha with staff and fur mantle on the path up to a walled city looks back at a dozen youths pointing and jeering behind him. White paper at the left/right edges and corners (accepted); nothing else wrong.

Jesus calls with arm raised toward the open dark tomb, stone rolled aside, five onlookers at right; Lazarus not yet out, as the verse has it. White paper at the bottom-left corner and upper-left edge (accepted).

Moses with rod raised by the rock, water pouring out, Aaron in jewelled breastplate, people filling jars, sheep, goats and cattle drinking. Painted to all edges; only quibble is Moses also holding a second crook staff.
Storm-tossed boat, a disciple gripping and shouting at Jesus just roused on the cushion in the stern, others rowing, bailing and hauling rope. Hands and faces sound, no marks or frame.

David stoops at the brook picking a smooth stone, staff and sling in his other hand, shepherd's bag at his hip; Saul and soldiers watch at left, Goliath and the Philistine line stand far right. No faults seen.

Moses with crook points away from the dark cloud-capped mountain toward open country while the people stand with loaded donkeys among tents. God is shown only as cloud on the peak, no figure; no lettering or anatomy problems.

Table under a tree before the house, March Hare, sleeping Dormouse and Hatter crowded together with tea things, Alice sitting put out in a large armchair at the end. Hat carries no lettered card, yellow dress and pinafore are not a film costume.

Court scene matches (White Rabbit in spectacles holding the verses, King, Queen, indignant Alice, jury with slates), but the Queen is the Tim Burton 2010 film Red Queen design (heart-shaped red hair, white face, blue eyeshadow to the brows, tiny crown; Helena Bonham Carter's character), breaking the no-film-likeness rule. Lettering: rows of pseudo-script on the Rabbit's paper, scribbles on papers on the floor and pips on the card soldiers, none readable.

The verse is the Obed-Jesse-David lineage, but the picture shows an elder reading from a blank scroll to six seated women in a courtyard with a couple in a doorway: no father-and-son generations, and the scroll reader is a reciter/narrator figure the text does not call for. Scroll is blank, anatomy fine.

Father runs with arms wide toward the ragged, weeping son on the road above the village and lake. Hands and faces sound; only an out-of-period white domed building with a slim tower in the background.

Watson holds the printed slip headed with the readable word 'Missing' above rows of pseudo-text; also labelled bottles, letters on the table and a newspaper stack with headline-like marks. Holmes's face (gaunt hollow cheeks, hooded eyes, swept-back hair, long upper lip) reads as Peter Cushing. White paper at edges and bottom corners (accepted).

Alice leans in with a raised finger at the long tea table under the tree, the Hatter wide-eyed with his cup and the March Hare beside him, house behind. White vignette at the left edge and corners (accepted); a small garbled teapot-like squiggle at the far left of the table is an object glitch, not a listed fault.

King in wig and crown shelters behind Alice as the grinning Cheshire Cat floats at left, Queen passing far right, hedgehogs and flamingos on the lawn. Only fault is heart pips on the bodies of the card soldiers in the background (no numerals, unreadable); a tiny blurred tumbling card figure back right is too small to count as anatomy.
A richly robed elder (Rephaiah) sets a stone on the city wall beside workers with mortar bowl, beam and baskets, Jerusalem's walls and temple behind. No faults seen.

Pillar of cloud stands over the tabernacle in its fenced court amid a vast pitched camp, people at chores and loading donkeys and carts. White paper along the top edge, top-right corner and sides (accepted); no figure in the cloud.

Masked King in the doorway, hand at his mask, blue cloak lined flame-colour, brooch and broad hat in hand, Holmes in the armchair and Watson seated with his bag. Only fault is marginal: faint smudge lines on the paper labels of chemical bottles (desk at left, top shelf at right), visible only when zoomed and unreadable. Painted to the edges; Holmes's profile is generic, not an actor.

Bald Elisha in a fur mantle walks the road outside the city gate while seven youths from the gate point and call after him. White paper at top, left and bottom edges and corners (accepted); hands sound.

David kneels at the stony brook with smooth stones in his palm, sling with a stone hanging from the other hand, staff on his shoulder and shepherd's bag at his hip, an armed Philistine approaching in the distance. No faults seen.

Dark bedroom: Holmes with a lit match raises his cane to lash, the bell-rope hangs from the smoking ventilator, Watson on the bed shields his eyes from the glare; no snake shown, as Watson saw none. Holmes's face is a gaunt type but not clearly any actor; no lettering.
Saul's arm is flung out, the spear in flight toward the cracked wall, David dodging away with his harp dropped. No spirit figure drawn, painted to the edges, hands sound.
Grinning Cheshire Cat with long claws on a bough, Alice looking up from below in a yellow dress. Thin sliver of white paper at the right edge and bottom-right corner (accepted); nothing else.

The verse is a teaching with no scene, and the picture is a lone man with a scroll and pen case at his belt gazing upward: the letter-writer (Paul) as narrator, a figure the text does not call for. No lettering on the scroll, anatomy fine.
Boat swamped in a wind storm, disciples bailing with buckets, Jesus asleep on the cushion in the stern, other small boats nearby. No faults seen.

Masked King in fur-trimmed blue coat with flame lining, hand to his mask and hat in hand, Holmes in the armchair with pipe and lens, Watson beside him with bowler and bag. Lettering: dial marks on the mantel clock and rows of text-like lines on the newspapers and papers on the floor and desk, none readable. Holmes is a gaunt type, not clearly an actor.

Giant Alice tips the jury-box, animal jurors tumbling out, the Lizard among them, King and Queen looking on. Lettering: an index 'A' on an ace-of-diamonds card figure (readable), pips on the card bodies and scribbles on papers and slates.

Samuel pours the horn of oil over kneeling David, a soft glow around him, Jesse at left and brothers at right. White paper on all edges (accepted); oddities not rising to a fault: a second horn at Samuel's belt and one brother in Roman-looking armour.

Holmes seated with pipe studying a woman's photograph while Watson stands by, which suits the passage. Lettering: an open book with lines of pseudo-text left of Watson and marks on the mantel clock face, none readable. Holmes's profile is generic.
Priest holding the pigeon bends beside the bronze horned altar with the ash heap next to it, tabernacle curtain and onlookers behind. Bird is intact, no gore, no divine figure.

Peter grasps the right hand of the lame man rising at the temple gate, crowd looking on. Lettering: glyph-like marks in the gilded frieze band above the gate, unreadable. White paper at the top-left corner and left edge (accepted).
Moses on a rock points away from the dark mountain as the people stand ready with loaded donkeys among the tents. No divine figure, no lettering, hands sound.

Table under a tree before a thatched house, Hare, Dormouse and Hatter crowded at one corner with the Hatter's elbow on the sleeping Dormouse, Alice in a big armchair at the far end, tea things only. Only fault is the card with scribbled marks tucked in the Hatter's hatband (unreadable).
Israelites walk the dry seabed at night between towering walls of water, an elder with a staff among them. No divine figure, no lettering, crowd faces and hands hold up.
Father running with open arms meets the ragged son reaching for him on the stony road, house behind. White paper at the bottom-left corner (accepted); hands sound.
Hezekiah in a blue robe directs men bringing grain and jars, one with a blank scroll, one kneeling in prayer, bronze sea on oxen and the temple behind. Frieze is ornament, not glyphs; no faults seen.
Father embraces the ragged son cheek to cheek on the road, house in the distance. Hands sound; no lettering or frame.

Saul stands cocked to throw a spear still in his hand while a second spear is already flying past the wall hanging toward fleeing David: the two throws shown at once. Wall-hanging motifs are geometric, not lettering; no spirit figure. White paper at the bottom-right corner and right edge (accepted).

Burning white house with three horse-drawn engines playing jets, Hatherley with bandaged hand, the station-master with lantern, Holmes and two bowler-hatted men on the road (they stride away from the fire rather than toward it, not counted). Holmes's face, in three-quarter view with hollow cheeks, bony brow, thin mouth and swept-back hair, reads clearly as Peter Cushing.
Courtyard with fire, Peter at left with hand on his chest, bound Jesus led by soldiers turning to look at him, rooster on the wall. No faults seen.

Station-master pointing, Hatherley with bandaged hand, Holmes and Watson on the road with the house ablaze and engines playing jets behind. Painted to the edges; Holmes is a small stylised hawk-nosed profile, not clearly an actor; cap badge is an emblem, not lettering.

Peter steps from the boat onto the water reaching toward Jesus standing on the waves, disciples watching from the boat. Ragged white paper at the lower right and left edges of the sea (accepted); hands sound.
